gmcm.section.ginger_island.title: Ginger Island Map Customization
gmcm.section.ginger_island.description: Configure map cleanup and obstacle removal for Ginger Island.
gmcm.remove_beach_farm_wreck.name: Remove Beach-Farm Passage Wreck
gmcm.remove_beach_farm_wreck.tooltip: Removes the wreckage, debris, and obstacle tiles along the pathway between Island South (beach) and Island West (farm) for a wide, clean transit.
gmcm.remove_island_west_shipwreck.name: Remove Island West Shipwreck
gmcm.remove_island_west_shipwreck.toolti: Removes the giant broken pirate shipwreck on the southern beach of Island West and replaces it with clean sandy beach.
